oracle_principles: Dependencies are bound to immutable logical identity plus exact predecessor outcome comment and body digest.
Only a unique immutable COMPLETED predecessor outcome can satisfy a dependency.
Blocked is not empty and is never closable.
GitHub observation must be stable under order permutation and fail closed on membership/content instability.
Exactly one runnable node is elected; parallel execution is outside Gate 2.
Durable JOB_STARTED is a replay fence and ambiguous recovery remains human-governed.
